existing_authority_audit.audit_finding: Prior artifacts did not select crust density/conductivity/heat production, crust expansivity/Cp, rhoAst/Tp intercept/solidus or complete profile mapping. No other authoritative ARCANA artifact was found to govern those values. The selections below are new specialist reference assumptions, not reconstructed T0 or Earth state.

radiogenic_heat_authority.uncertainty_policy: These are authorial specialist reference values with stated literature-based sensitivity, not cellwise fields or reconstructed Earth.

potential_temperature_K.derivation: nominal HWR Tb - gamma*100 km; gamma=alpha*g*T/Cp, evaluated locally at Tb; range is conservative combination of HWR Tb, alpha, Cp extrema

asthenosphere_reference.adiabatic_relation: dT/dz=alpha*g*T/Cp; use exponential integration T(z)=Tp*exp(alpha*g*z/Cp) for constant properties; linear GRADIE is local derivative only.
asthenosphere_reference.TADIAB_binding: Set TADIAB=Tp at the reference surface-pressure datum z=0; GRADIE=local derivative at Tp for compatibility only; TAsthK at 100 km is derived from integrated adiabat and must be evaluated through explicit code binding. The source's linear formula differs from exact integration by <0.1 K over 100 km at nominal values.

rhoAst.binding: same mantle density authority evaluated at potential-temperature reference

asthenosphere_reference.alpha: same selected mantle alpha authority used for lithosphere and adiabat; do not create duplicate value.
asthenosphere_reference.solidus_limits: No universal solidus is assigned: temLim in this source is a numerical density-integration cap and literature solidus varies with composition, pressure and volatiles. This is outside the minimal conductive reference-state authority; any required runtime cap must be separately governed before OrbData config.

hwr_to_lab_mapping.physical_basis: In HWR-2, zp is depth from surface to the lower fixed-temperature boundary of the finite conductive plate, not mantle-only thickness. It is a plate thermal boundary depth, not a universal mechanical LAB definition.
hwr_to_lab_mapping.ARCANA_runtime_mapping: For the explicit layered geometric bookkeeping only, h_total=z_p; h_mantle=z_p-h_ocean_crust. This does not assert that the layered steady geotherm reproduces HWR-2 transient T(z,t). The basal thermal boundary is T_b at nominal zp=100 km.
hwr_to_lab_mapping.fail_closed: If zp<=h_crust, reject the ocean column; do not clamp, substitute another thickness, or infer mantle thickness independently.

continental_geometry_binding.mantle_thickness: h_total - cellwise authored continental crust thickness
continental_geometry_binding.failure: nonpositive mantle residual is invalid; never clamp

ocean_geometry_binding.ridge: z=0 age uses finite q_ridge=0.3; zp nominal supplies only an explicitly authorial reference geometry until a ridge initial thermal profile is specified

isostatic_binding.thermal_density: rho_thermal=rho_ref*exp(-alpha*(T-Tref)); source's linear rho_ref*[1-alpha*(T-Tref)] may be used only as first-order approximation and must be tested against same reference T.
isostatic_binding.chemical_density: delta_rho_chemical is independent authored/compositional input; currently zero reference anomaly only (no compositional map), not an inversion residual.
isostatic_binding.delta_rho_limit: Do not use stock +/-100 kg m-3 as ARCANA physics. Until chemical bounds exist, no clipping is allowed; out-of-bound chemical input fails closed.
isostatic_binding.water: rhoH2O=1000 kg m-3 (990-1030) only over seawater column.
isostatic_binding.reference_temperatures: Crust reference density at TSurf=280 K; lithosphere/asthenosphere reference density at Tp=1638.8 K; use those same references in density correction.

curvature_policy.reason: A0.6G nominal column validation shows the heat-flow/thickness inputs do not fit the source's steady piecewise quadratic profile for young ocean, ridge, or all continental classes. A fitted curvature would mask this transient/steady mismatch and risks Moho flux discontinuity.
curvature_policy.conservative_interface: Require T continuity and q above Moho = q below Moho = q_s-A_C*h_C. No interface source/sink.
curvature_policy.source_change: Disable curvature in reference calculation; later transient solver may use CURVATURE_REFORMULATED_CONSERVATIVE only if it enforces both layer balances and interface flux exactly.

analytical_column_checks.method: Independent static evaluation of the piecewise steady constant-property equations from the A0.6F contract. Nominal reference values above. Crust thickness representatives: continent 50 km cold, 35 km normal, 25 km hot; ocean 6.5 km. TSurf=280 K. No OrbData run.

sensitivity_extremes.ocean_youngest: At q=0.474 W/m2, kM=4.1, AM=0.04 uW/m3, and zp=80 km, the steady reconstruction still yields a many-thousand-kelvin base, far above HWR Tb; A_M range cannot resolve transient/steady mismatch.
sensitivity_extremes.continental_classes: Corner sweep over kC=2-3, AC=0.4-1.2 uW/m3, kM=3-4.1, AM=0-0.04 uW/m3 with prescribed representative crust thicknesses found no single shared parameter corner placing all three continental LAB temperatures within 1600-1720 K while keeping qMoho nonnegative. This is a sensitivity diagnostic, not exhaustive proof over continuous intervals.
sensitivity_extremes.solidus: No temLim selected; no solidus pass can be claimed. Young/ridge nominal computed maxima exceed plausible silicate solidus regimes; report as failure, not cap.
sensitivity_extremes.density: Thermal density factors can be evaluated algebraically, but extreme unphysical temperatures make resulting density corrections meaningless; isostatic validation fails for those columns.

analytical_column_checks.moho_energy_check: All listed columns conserve flux analytically at the Moho because qmoho is computed as q_s-A_C*hC and same value initializes mantle. This is a formula-level pass, not source qualification.
analytical_column_checks.surface_check: All listed cases retain prescribed q exactly.
analytical_column_checks.thickness_check: All listed representative thickness residuals are positive; this alone does not establish thermal compatibility.
analytical_column_checks.overall: FAIL: A0.6D HWR-2 surface q(t) is transient, while audited OrbData builds a steady layered quadratic geotherm across the full plate. At young ages, preserving both HWR q and 100-km plate depth gives impossible steady temperatures. Continental authored q/thickness pairs also do not all meet one global asthenosphere reference with the chosen homogeneous material model. A material-property package cannot cure this structural incompatibility.

material_package_status.reason: A0.6G requested reusable V1 only if column values can be validated; static checks fail for the prescribed hybrid steady/transient pairing.

config_v1_readiness.reason: Heat-flow Config V1 would bind a source profile known to violate basal temperature and physical limits for representative required cells.

remaining_scientific_blockers.statement: The mandated HWR-2 transient conductive surface flux and selected total thermal thickness cannot be represented by OrbData's steady piecewise quadratic crust/mantle profile over youngest positive ocean ages, ridge, and all authored continental q/thickness classes while preserving surface flux, one LAB adiabat and physical temperatures. The minimum missing authority is the producer-to-OrbData column-state mapping: OrbData must consume a compatible age-dependent temperature profile (or a scientifically justified equivalent) rather than interpreting transient q as steady state; continental class q/thickness consistency must be resolved in the same reference model.
remaining_scientific_blockers.why_smallest: This is the shared coupling condition that all material parameters feed; further point-value tuning would distort existing T0/HWR authorities or hide the inconsistency.
